text:
Joanna: small life update 10 10 promoted to Staff PM and... we're pregnant! due October. thinking a low-key potluck + quick toast Friday at noon in the big kitchen. anyone up for bringing something?
Ravi: oh wow holy cow congrats on both!! count me in for potluck. what should I bring?
Joanna: yay!! honestly anything easy. maybe a salad or sandwich platter. also no pressure on gifts 10
Sam: massive congrats Joanna!! I can bring dessert (mini tarts). also happy to make a quick sign-up sheet so we don't double up.
Lin: congrats 10!! I can bring a veggie platter and label for dietary restrictions.
Mei: yay congrats Joanna! Ill bring something gluten-free. do you want a card?
Joanna: a card would be lovely but totally optional. if anyone wants to chip in for a small baby book, DM me and I'll share a link.
pyro-bot: Suggested event: "Joanna: promo + baby potluck" Fri 12:00 PM 12 Office Kitchen. React with :thumbsup: to RSVP.
Theo: :thumbsup:  i'll be there and will bring napkins/plates so we're covered.
Aisha: congrats!! quick q: are we doing a short toast? I can keep it to 1-2 mins.
Joanna: short toast would be lovely but not required. really just want to eat cake with you all :)
Sam: made an anonymous sign-up (just food items + dietary tags): https://forms.gle/joanna-potluck (short link).
Ravi: adding to calendar now. also sending a small congratulations GIF in the thread.
Mei: i vote cupcakes + one savory.
Lin: noting dairy-free option from me.
pyro-bot: Event created: "Joanna: promo + baby potluck" Fri 12:00 PM 12 Office Kitchen. Invites sent to team@redwood.com
Aisha: sending a tiny congratulations voice note to Joanna now.
Joanna: you all are so kind 10 thank you, can't wait to celebrate with you.
Sam: see you friday 10 :cake:
